# Data sources

All files are exports from the city's open-data portal
(`https://data.portalder.example`), downloaded on 2026-09-15. They are
fictional, written for this example.

- `bus-ridership.csv` — annual boardings, in millions, from the transit
  agency. **2026 covers January to August only** (`months_covered`).
- `water-rates.csv` — residential water tariff: a fixed monthly charge plus
  a rate per 1,000 gallons. A typical household uses about 5,000 gallons a
  month.
- `city-budget-2026.csv` — the adopted 2026 budget, by category.
- `potholes-repaired.csv` — potholes repaired per year. **Digital records
  start in 2019**; earlier years were kept on paper and were never
  published. 2026 covers January to August.
- `school-enrollment.csv` — students enrolled in the city's public school
  district, per school year.
- `library-hours.csv` — weekly open hours per library branch.
- `streetlights.csv` — streetlight inventory by technology.
